  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libxaac/decoder/armv8/ixheaacd_qmf_dec_armv8.c","function":"ixheaacd_cplx_anal_qmffilt_32","line":593,"var":"analysis_buffer","code":"ixheaacd_fwd_modulation(analysis_buffer, qmf_real[i], qmf_imag[i], qmf_bank, qmf_dec_tables_ptr, 1);","note":"The function forwards the stack buffer to modulation without first initializing every element."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libxaac/decoder/armv8/ixheaacd_qmf_dec_armv8.c","function":"ixheaacd_fwd_modulation","line":296,"var":"p_time_in1 / p_time_in2","code":"for (i = qmf_bank->no_channels - 1; i >= 0; i--) { ... *t_real_subband++ = ...; *t_imag_subband++ = ...; }","note":"Only part of the local buffer is written from input-derived samples; the remaining slots stay uninitialized."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libxaac/decoder/armv8/ixheaacd_qmf_dec_armv8.c","function":"ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod","line":258,"var":"subband_tmp","code":"WORD32 subband_tmp[128];","note":"The modulation helper allocates another local temporary array that is used as an intermediate FFT/QMF workspace."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libxaac/decoder/armv8/ixheaacd_qmf_dec_armv8.c","function":"ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod","line":267,"var":"subband_tmp","code":"ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod_loop1(subband, M, p_sin_cos, subband_tmp);","note":"The first loop populates only the portions derived from the partially initialized subband data."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libxaac/decoder/armv8/ixheaacd_qmf_dec_armv8.c","function":"ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod","line":279,"var":"subband_tmp[64]","code":"ixheaacd_sbr_imdct_using_fft((const WORD32 *)p_twiddle, 32, &subband_tmp[64], &subband[64], ...);","note":"The second FFT/IMDCT call consumes the upper half of subband_tmp, which can still contain uninitialized stack bytes."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/libxaac/decoder/armv8/ixheaacd_qmf_dec_armv8.c","function":"ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod","line":293,"var":"subband","code":"ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod_loop2(subband, p_sin, M);","note":"The final modulation step propagates the tainted/uninitialized values into the output subband array, creating the memory-safety sink."}

PY
